title: Review
description: What every probe is handed about the review it takes part in, resolved once by the reviewing context: the pull request, the head commit, every changed file as fragments of lines, and where the probe writes its rows of the ledger

files.description: Every changed file that has surface lines, whole: its fragments in file order at the head commit, then the fragments the change removed

LedgerFile.description: The file the probe writes its rows of the ledger to, by its path on the machine the review runs on. The only file a probe touches

ReportCommand.description: The command a probe checks its ledger file with before it returns: the skill's check script, run on the probe's own instructions file. It applies every check the review applies to that file, and says what it rejects

pullRequest.author: agent-rasmus[bot]
pullRequest.description: A published site is valid and its links hold. Verify runs html-validate and lychee.
